standard_prerequisites.name: Strictly perfect representatives
standard_prerequisites.use: Affine locally, E is represented by a strictly perfect complex of O_X-modules.

core_obligations: Claim the criterion applies: conditions (1) and (2) (properness, flatness of O_X over f^{-1}O_S) are immediate from the hypotheses.
Condition (3) is local on X; assume X and S affine and E represented by a strictly perfect complex.
O_X is flat as a sheaf of f^{-1}O_S-modules, so the strictly perfect complex satisfies condition (3); conclude Rf_*E is perfect.
